rules: Allocation follows FEFO: for each product, stock must come from the eligible lot with the earliest expiry date (ties: lower lot id) before any later-expiring lot is used. Only free quantity (lot quantity minus what open orders have allocated) can be allocated or moved; a lot's quantity cannot be adjusted below what is allocated from it, and a lot with allocations cannot be quarantined - release the orders' allocations first.

Bins hold one product only. Ambient products go to ambient or bulk bins, chilled products to chilled bins, hazmat products to hazmat bins. Blocked bins cannot receive stock or be picked from, but stock may be moved out of them. A bin's units may not exceed its capacity.

A shipment needs a fully allocated order that is not on hold, booked with the same carrier and service as the order (use change_carrier to change them). Ship dates must be working days (Monday-Friday), not in the past and not later than the ship-by date; shipping today is only possible before the carrier's cut-off time. Orders with hazmat products need a carrier that takes hazardous goods. No parcel may exceed the carrier's max_parcel_g, and the parcels together must weigh at least the goods weight.

Orders can only be split while new and unallocated; at least one unit must stay on the original order.

Bins hold one product only. Ambient products go to ambient or bulk bins, chilled products to chilled bins, hazmat products to hazmat bins. Blocked bins cannot receive stock or be picked from, but stock may be moved out of them. A bin's units may not exceed its capacity.

A shipment needs a fully allocated order that is not on hold, booked with the same carrier and service as the order (use change_carrier to change them). Ship dates must be working days (Monday-Friday), not in the past and not later than the ship-by date; shipping today is only possible before the carrier's cut-off time. Orders with hazmat products need a carrier that takes hazardous goods. No parcel may exceed the carrier's max_parcel_g, and the parcels together must weigh at least the goods weight.

Orders can only be split while new and unallocated; at least one unit must stay on the original order.

rules: Allocation follows FEFO: for each product, stock must come from the eligible lot with the earliest expiry date (ties: lower lot id) before any later-expiring lot is used. Only free quantity (lot quantity minus what open orders have allocated) can be allocated or moved; a lot's quantity cannot be adjusted below what is allocated from it, and a lot with allocations cannot be quarantined - release the orders' allocations first.

Bins hold one product only. Ambient products go to ambient or bulk bins, chilled products to chilled bins, hazmat products to hazmat bins. Blocked bins cannot receive stock or be picked from, but stock may be moved out of them. A bin's units may not exceed its capacity.
